Reasons: `oversize`, `oversize_combined`, `parser_oversize`, `arrow_offset_overflow`, `unsafe_path`, `deeply_nested`, `stack_limit`, `too_many_edges`, per-phase CPU-budget timeouts `timeout_parse`, `timeout_walk`, `timeout_ssa`, `timeout_sentinel`, and the per-file resolve timeout `timeout_resolve`. Cross-file stops `too_many_names` and `timeout_cross_file` count once per language family per run, with an empty path. `too_many_manifest_bytes` counts a manifest that stays in the graph but is not read for resolution, and `fqn_truncated` a file whose deepest definitions keep only the last 64 segments (or 4 KiB) of their qualified name. `language` comes from the file extension, `unknown` when none matches.
